messages:
maria: Quick question — about to switch inference-svc targetPort from 8080 -> 8081 and flip the Gateway to NLB passthrough for the new nodepool. Can I get a quick sanity check?

ken: what's the motivation? latency?

maria: yes, new model container listens on 8081 and we want TLS passthrough at L4 so we don't terminate at ALB. hoping to avoid additional proxy TLS unwrap.

raj: ok but health probes — are you updating readiness/liveness to hit 8081 too? NLB healthchecks will use nodeport. If svc.targetPort != containerPort we need probe.targetPort matching or use numeric port.

maria: I planned to change the k8s svc to: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: inference-svc
  namespace: infra-inference
spec:
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
    - name: tls
      port: 443
      targetPort: 8081
  selector:
    app: inference
  externalTrafficPolicy: Local
```

ken: externalTrafficPolicy: Local is important for NLB healthchecks, good call. But note: if any nodes without pods get probed you may see unhealthy backends. Make sure daemonset or pod distro covers all nodes in the pool.

maria: good point. We'll add nodeSelector to pin pods to the new nodepool. Also need to wire Gateway API secretbinding: gateway expects a TLS Secret in the gateway namespace, but our cert is in infra-inference namespace. Who owns the cross-namespace secret binding?

raj: short answer: Gateway API requires the secret to be in the gateway namespace (or use SecretBinding CRD in our cluster). Ops-bot can create a SecretBinding that references the infra cert and exposes a namespaced secret for the gateway. @ops-bot can you confirm?

ops-bot: creating SecretBinding 'inference-cert-binding' in ns 'gateway-system' referencing secret 'infra-inference/tls-inference'... :spinner:

ops-bot: done — SecretBinding created. you can reference `secretRef: { name: inference-cert-binding }` from the Gateway TLS config. :white_check_mark:

devex-jen: tiny nit — when you change svc.targetPort we should also update any terraform module that manages the Service so it doesn't get drifted on next apply. Add a note to the PR and bump the module var.

maria: posting PR now. Terraform snippet in the PR: 
```hcl
resource "kubernetes_service" "inference" {
  metadata { name = "inference-svc" namespace = "infra-inference" }
  spec {
    type = "LoadBalancer"
    port { name = "tls" port = 443 target_port = 8081 protocol = "TCP" }
    selector = { app = "inference" }
  }
}
```

raj: LGTM. Also check healthcheck protocol — NLB performs TCP healthchecks by default for passthrough. For readiness path-based checking you’d need ALB.

ken: last check — firewall and loadBalancerSourceRanges? Are we locking LB to customer CIDR? If so, NLB passthrough + TLS should be fine but confirm source ranges include the region pools.

maria: LB is open to 0.0.0.0/0 for now (public model endpoint). We'll add WAF later.

ops-bot: terraform plan for module "infra-inference-service" at 2025-11-02T10:23:45Z: 1 to change, 0 to add, 0 to destroy. :eyes:

ken: once PR is up @maria ping me for review. I'll watch the canary nodepool rollout.

maria: thanks — will do. If anything flaps after switching targetPort I'll revert to targetPort: 8080 and route through ALB TLS termination.

raj: one more note — update the docs (eng-infra/runbooks/inference-lb.md) with the new targetPort and secret binding steps. Saves everyone 15m next time. :memo:
